requirements.text: The portal must allow patients to manage their appointments online, including the ability to book, cancel, and reschedule appointments.
The system should provide options for appointment reminders via SMS and email, with the ability to customize preferences and send reminders one or two days prior to appointments.
Patients must be able to request repeat prescriptions online, with clear instructions and guidance, such as a checklist or prompts, to minimize errors.
Security measures must include strong verification processes, such as multi-factor authentication, to ensure that only authorized users can access sensitive information.
The portal must maintain a user-friendly interface that supports patients who may not be tech-savvy, ensuring that all features are accessible and easy to navigate.
